title: Key of the House of David

request.style: English, gentle female solo voice, soft piano, acoustic guitar, light strings, warm and hopeful mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On that day I will summon my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah
I will clothe him with your robe and fasten your sash around him
I will hand your authority over to him
He will be a father to those who live in Jerusalem

[Pre-Chorus]
I will place the key of the house of David on his shoulder
What he opens no one will shut
What he shuts no one will open

[Chorus]
He is like a peg in a firm place
A throne of honor for his father's house
The glory of the offspring hangs upon him
The small vessels and the jars are his

[Verse]
When the Assyrian commander came with threats
Eliakim asked him to speak in Aramaic
So the people on the wall would not hear the fear
But the Rabshakeh stood and called out loudly

[Pre-Chorus]
We tore our clothes and went to seek Isaiah
To hear the word of the Lord of hosts
To find the guidance that we needed then
To stand firm in the face of the storm

[Chorus]
He is like a peg in a firm place
A throne of honor for his father's house
The glory of the offspring hangs upon him
The small vessels and the jars are his

[Chorus]
He is like a peg in a firm place
A throne of honor for his father's house
The glory of the offspring hangs upon him
The small vessels and the jars are his

[Outro]
The key of the house of David is on his shoulder
What he opens no one will shut
What he shuts no one will open
